changes: Validator now enforces every JSON Schema keyword currently used by the canonical schemas and fails closed on unsupported schema keywords
Added task/result pair validation for task ID, repository, effect class, branch, authorization-record path and bound PR number
Added negative contract tests for unknown fields, invalid enums, invalid dates, duplicates, malformed repository names, invalid SHA, incompatible result state and task/result mismatches
Preserved validation of historical 003 authorization/result records without rewriting them
Added optional Worker Result history metadata fields for future post-transition/supersession records
Pinned external GitHub Actions to exact commit SHAs
Set explicit least-privilege contents: read permissions on all repository workflows
material_non_effects: No branch protection or ruleset change
residual_blockers: Protecting main with a ruleset requires Owner approval
Selecting a repository license requires Owner decision
A full E2E proof in PINK IPTV, FADEGO, or VCAM-PRO requires separate authorization to mutate that managed repository
Publishing a versioned GitHub Release remains a release Human Gate
